headword: {自律神経失調症|じりつしんけいしっちょうしょう}
reading: じりつしんけいしっちょうしょう

definitions.gloss: autonomic nervous system disorder; imbalance of the autonomic nerves
definitions.explanation: A label used widely in Japan for a cluster of symptoms — dizziness, fatigue, palpitations, sweating, insomnia — attributed to an imbalance between the sympathetic and parasympathetic nervous systems. Commonly linked to stress, irregular hours, and seasonal change.

examples.english: I fall ill whenever the seasons change, so I'm worried it might be an autonomic nervous system disorder.

notes:
A broad, everyday diagnostic label rather than a precisely defined disease; Japanese speakers use it conversationally for run-down periods with no clear organic cause.
